title: Long deck 300 pptx 002
notes: 300-slide pagination/theme stress; deck size is the feature. Same single blank layout (slide_layouts[6]) on all 300 slides, but the textbox position ALTERNATES between two placements — odd slides at (0.6in, 0.6in), even slides at (1.2in, 2.2in) — so geometry varies while the layout chain stays constant; each slide carries a 'Slide {i}' title line plus three buChar bullets drawn from a fixed 12-phrase NATO cycle. reference_text is the exact title+bullets of every slide in order (1200 lines).
